info.description:
Experience APIs to manage the HR Worker Profile implementation by WorkforceNow. Employee Job Change Application Programming Interface (API) adds a new position for an employee and updates the primary position of an employee in ADP Workforce Now. For more info refer Employee Job Change API Guide for ADP Workforce Now.


The Regular Pay Application Programming Interface (API) is used to change the base remuneration details of an employee. For more information refer Regular Pay API Guide for ADP Workforce Now


The Taxable/Reportable Benefits Application Programming Interface (API) is used to retrieve, add, and change an employee's taxable benefits details. For more information refer Taxable/Reportable Benefits API Guide for ADP Workforce Now

Important: The Taxable/Reportable Benefits API can only be used to retrieve, add, and change taxable benefit details for a paid employee in Canada.


The Corporate Groups Application Programming Interface (API) is used to change the corporate group details of an employee. For more information refer Corporate Groups API Guide for ADP Workforce Now.

The Additional Earnings Application Programming Interface (API) is used to add or update or get the additional remuneration details of an employee. For more information refer Additional Earnings API Guide for ADP Workforce Now.
